annotations.title: GPUs needed to host a model

description:
How many GPUs it takes to self-host an open-weight LLM at a given quantization,
        and the cheapest rental setups for it right now. quant is one of: fp16, bf16, fp8,
        mxfp8, int8, q6, fp6, q5, q4km, nvfp4, awq, mxfp4, gptq, int4, q3, q2, iq2, iq1.
        Estimates memory only (weights + 20% runtime overhead), not throughput. limit: 1-10.

limit.description: Maximum rows to return, 1-10; values outside the range are clamped.
limit.title: Limit

model.description: LLM name or slug (e.g. "gpt-oss-120b", "deepseek-v3"). Use find_model if unsure of the name.
model.title: Model

quant.description: Weight precision / quantization format (case-insensitive). fp16/bf16 is full size, fp8 and int8 half that, the 4-bit formats about a quarter.
quant.title: Quant
